034/**
035 * Basic implementation of {@link WritableBeanStore}.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * A simple storage database for beans keyed by type and name.
039 * Used to retrieve and instantiate beans using an injection-like API.
040 * It's similar in concept to the injection framework of Spring but greatly simplified in function and not intended to implement a full-fledged injection framework.
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * Beans can be stored with or without names.  Named beans are typically resolved using
044 * the <ja>@Name</ja> or <ja>@Qualified</ja> annotations on constructor or method parameters.
045 *
046 * <p>
047 * This implementation is thread-safe and supports parent bean stores for hierarchical bean resolution.
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>Resolution order:</h5>
050 * <p>
051 * Bean lookups consult the following sources in this order, returning the first match:
052 * <ol>
053 *    <li>{@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore,BeanStore) Overriding parent} (e.g. a Spring application context bridge), if non-{@code null}.
054 *    <li>Local entries added via {@link #addBean(Class,Object) addBean} / {@link #addSupplier(Class,Supplier) addSupplier}.
055 *    <li>Regular {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore) parent}, if non-{@code null}.
056 *    <li>Local default suppliers added via {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier) addDefaultSupplier} (memoizer-backed framework defaults).
057 * </ol>
058 *
059 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
060 *    <li class='jc'>{@link BeanStore} - Read-only bean lookup interface
061 *    <li class='jc'>{@link WritableBeanStore} - Writable bean store interface
062 * </ul>
063 */
064@SuppressWarnings({
065   "java:S115",  // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., PROP_bean)
066   "java:S135",  // @PreDestroy/@Bean discovery loops use per-element continue guards for clarity; refactoring obscures the per-annotation filter chain
067   "java:S3011", // setAccessible(true) is required to invoke private/package-private @Bean members and @PreDestroy methods via reflection
068   "java:S3776", // matchesConditions and registerConfiguration intentionally centralize the @Conditional/@Bean discovery state machine; splitting hurts cohesion
069   "resource" // BeanStore is a fluent AutoCloseable; self-returns and owned/sentinel stores are not new resources to close.
070})
071public class BasicBeanStore implements WritableBeanStore {
072   private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(BasicBeanStore.class.getName());
073
074   /**
075    * Static reusable empty instance.
076    *
077    * <p>
078    * Useful as a placeholder when an API requires a {@link BeanStore} but the caller has no beans to
079    * register &mdash; e.g. as the parent argument to a builder that only needs the bean store for
080    * downstream parameter resolution.
081    *
082    * <p>
083    * <b>Treat this instance as read-only.</b>  It's typed as the concrete class so it can be passed
084    * to APIs that take {@link WritableBeanStore} or {@code BasicBeanStore}, but callers should not
085    * call any mutating methods on it &mdash; doing so would leak state between unrelated callers.
086    * Code that legitimately needs to add beans should construct its own {@code new BasicBeanStore()}.
087    */
088   public static final BasicBeanStore INSTANCE = new BasicBeanStore();
089

091   private static final String PROP_bean = "bean";
092   private static final String PROP_defaults = "defaults";
093   private static final String PROP_entries = "entries";
094   private static final String PROP_identity = "identity";
095   private static final String PROP_name = "name";
096   private static final String PROP_overlayStack = "overlayStack";
097   private static final String PROP_overridingParent = "overridingParent";
098   private static final String PROP_parent = "parent";
099   private static final String PROP_type = "type";
100
101   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
102   private static final String ARG_beanType = "beanType";
103   private static final String ARG_onClassOrObject = "onClassOrObject";

105   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,Supplier<?>>> entries;
106   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,Supplier<?>>> defaults;
107   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,BeanSourceMeta>> entryMetadata;
108   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,ConcurrentHashMap<String,BeanSourceMeta>> defaultMetadata;
109   private final ConcurrentHashMap<Class<?>,Class<?>> typeBindings;
110   private final List<Object> resolvedBeans;
111   private final Set<Object> resolvedIdentities;
112   private final Set<Class<?>> registeredConfigurations;
113   private final BeanStore parent;
114   private final BeanStore overridingParent;
115   @SuppressWarnings({
116      "java:S3077" // volatile is required here for correct double-checked-locking safe-publication of the lazily-created StackOverlay in pushOverlay(); the reference is publish-once and never compound-mutated.
117   })
118   private volatile StackOverlay overlayStack;
119   private volatile boolean closed;

121   /**
122    * No-arg constructor.  Equivalent to {@code new BasicBeanStore(null)}.
123    *
124    * <p>
125    * Creates a standalone, parent-less bean store.  All lookups consult only locally-registered beans and
126    * default suppliers.
127    */
128   public BasicBeanStore() {
129      this(null, null);
130   }
131
132   /**
133    * Constructor.
134    *
135    * @param parent The parent bean store.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.  Bean searches are performed recursively up this parent chain
136    *    <i>after</i> local entries are checked.
137    */
138   public BasicBeanStore(BeanStore parent) {
139      this(parent, null);
140   }
141
142   /**
143    * Constructor that accepts an overriding parent bean store.
144    *
145    * <p>
146    * The {@code overridingParent} is consulted <i>before</i> any local entries during bean lookup, allowing an outer
147    * scope (typically a Spring {@code ApplicationContext} bridge) to take precedence over local registrations.  The
148    * regular {@code parent} continues to be consulted as a fallback after local entries.
149    *
150    * <p>
151    * Final resolution order:
152    * <ol>
153    *    <li>{@code overridingParent} (if non-{@code null})
154    *    <li>local entries (added via {@link #addBean(Class,Object) addBean} / {@link #addSupplier(Class,Supplier) addSupplier})
155    *    <li>regular {@code parent} (if non-{@code null})
156    *    <li>local default suppliers (added via {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier) addDefaultSupplier})
157    * </ol>
158    *
159    * @param parent The parent bean store, used as a fallback after local entries.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (this store then has no parent fallback).
160    * @param overridingParent The overriding parent bean store, consulted before local entries.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (no overriding parent is consulted).
161    */
162   public BasicBeanStore(BeanStore parent, BeanStore overridingParent) {
163      this.parent = parent;
164      this.overridingParent = overridingParent;
165      entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
166      defaults = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
167      entryMetadata = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
168      defaultMetadata = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
169      typeBindings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
170      resolvedBeans = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
171      resolvedIdentities = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
172      registeredConfigurations = Collections.synchronizedSet(new HashSet<>());
173      addSupplier(BasicBeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
174      addSupplier(BeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
175      addSupplier(WritableBeanStore.class, ()->this, null);
176   }

234   /**
235    * Adds a supplier for an unnamed bean of the specified type to this store.
236    *
237    * <p>
238    * The supplier will be invoked lazily when the bean is first requested.
239    *
240    * @param <T> The class to associate this bean with.
241    * @param beanType The class to associate this bean with.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
242    * @param bean The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
243    * @return This object.
244    */
245   @Override
246   public <T> BasicBeanStore addSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> bean) {
247      return addSupplier(beanType, bean, null);
248   }

250   /**
251    * Adds a supplier for a named bean of the specified type to this store.
252    *
253    * <p>
254    * The supplier will be invoked lazily when the bean is first requested.
255    *
256    * @param <T> The class to associate this bean with.
257    * @param beanType The class to associate this bean with.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
258    * @param bean The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
259    * @param name The bean name if this is a named bean.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
260    * @return This object.
261    */
262   @Override
263   public <T> BasicBeanStore addSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> bean, String name) {
264      checkOpen();
265      var typeMap = entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
266      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
267      typeMap.put(key, bean);
268      entryMetadata.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).put(key, BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT);
269      return this;
270   }

275    * <p>
276    * Default suppliers are consulted only after local {@linkplain #addBean(Class,Object) entries} and the regular
277    * {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore) parent} have been searched.  They are intended for memoizer-backed
278    * framework defaults that should not shadow explicit user registrations or beans inherited from an
279    * {@linkplain #BasicBeanStore(BeanStore,BeanStore) overriding parent} (e.g. Spring).
280    *
281    * @param <T> The bean type.
282    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
283    * @param supplier The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
284    * @return This object.
285    */
286   @Override
287   public <T> BasicBeanStore addDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> supplier) {
288      return addDefaultSupplier(beanType, supplier, null);
289   }

291   /**
292    * Adds a fallback supplier for a named bean of the specified type to this store.
293    *
294    * <p>
295    * See {@link #addDefaultSupplier(Class,Supplier)} for ordering semantics.
296    *
297    * @param <T> The bean type.
298    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
299    * @param supplier The bean supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
300    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
301    * @return This object.
302    */
303   @Override
304   public <T> BasicBeanStore addDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, Supplier<T> supplier, String name) {
305      checkOpen();
306      var typeMap = defaults.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
307      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
308      typeMap.put(key, supplier);
309      defaultMetadata.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).put(key, BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT);
310      return this;
311   }
312
313   /**
314    * Promotes every locally-registered default supplier to a local entry supplier of the same name and type.
315    *
316    * <p>
317    * Default suppliers normally resolve at tier 4 (after the regular parent walk), which means a parent
318    * store's default supplier wins over this store's default supplier when both are registered for the same
319    * type.  Promoting moves each default into the tier-2 local-entry slot so that this store's framework
320    * defaults take precedence over the parent's same-type defaults &mdash; useful for embedded sub-contexts
321    * (e.g. per-mixin {@code RestContext}s) that need their own framework objects (serializer set, parser set,
322    * call logger, etc.) even though the parent is parent-linked for non-framework bean lookups.
323    *
324    * <p>
325    * The original default-supplier registrations are left in place; promoted entries that already exist as
326    * local entries are not overwritten.  Promotion is idempotent and only affects suppliers registered prior
327    * to the call &mdash; later {@code addDefaultSupplier(...)} calls do not retroactively promote.
328    *
329    * @return This object.
330    * @since 10.0.0
331    */
332   public BasicBeanStore promoteDefaultsToLocalSuppliers() {
333      checkOpen();
334      defaults.forEach((beanType, typeMap) -> typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> {
335         var localTypeMap = entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
336         localTypeMap.putIfAbsent(name, supplier);
337         entryMetadata.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).putIfAbsent(name, BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT);
338      }));
339      return this;
340   }
341
342   @Override
343   public Snapshot pushOverlay(BeanStore overlay) {
344      Objects.requireNonNull(overlay, "overlay must not be null");
345      checkOpen();
346      var stack = overlayStack;
347      if (stack == null) {
348         synchronized (this) {
349            stack = overlayStack;
350            if (stack == null) {
351               stack = new StackOverlay();
352               overlayStack = stack;
353            }
354         }
355      }
356      stack.push(overlay);
357      return new Snapshot(this, overlay);
358   }
359
360   @Override
361   public void popOverlay(Snapshot snapshot) {
362      Objects.requireNonNull(snapshot, "snapshot must not be null");
363      checkOpen();
364      if (snapshot.owner() != this)
365         throw new IllegalStateException("Snapshot does not belong to this BeanStore (foreign-snapshot pop).");
366      var stack = overlayStack;
367      if (stack == null || stack.depth() == 0)
368         throw new IllegalStateException("popOverlay invoked on an empty overlay stack.");
369      // LIFO discipline — the snapshot must identify the current top-of-stack frame.
370      var top = stack.peek();
371      if (top != snapshot.frame())
372         throw new IllegalStateException(
373            "Out-of-order popOverlay: supplied snapshot does not identify the top-of-stack overlay frame.");
374      stack.pop();
375   }

378    * Removes all beans from this store.

382    *
383    * @return This object.
384    */
385   @Override
386   public BasicBeanStore clear() {
387      checkOpen();
388      entries.clear();
389      defaults.clear();
390      entryMetadata.clear();
391      defaultMetadata.clear();
392      registeredConfigurations.clear();
393      return this;
394   }

396   /**
397    * Returns the unnamed bean of the specified type.
398    *
399    * <p>
400    * If no unnamed bean is found in this store, searches the parent store recursively.
401    *
402    * @param <T> The type of bean to return.
403    * @param beanType The type of bean to return.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
404    * @return The bean, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.
405    */
406   @Override
407   public <T> Optional<T> getBean(Class<T> beanType) {
408      return getBean(beanType, null);
409   }

411
412   /**
413    * Returns the named bean of the specified type.
414    *
415    * <p>
416    * If no bean with the specified name is found in this store, searches the parent store recursively.
417    *
418    * @param <T> The type of bean to return.
419    * @param beanType The type of bean to return.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
420    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
421    * @return The bean, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.
422    */
423   @Override
424   public <T> Optional<T> getBean(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
425      checkOpen();
426      if (name == null) {
427         var unnamed = resolve(beanType, null).map(Supplier::get);
428         if (unnamed.isPresent())
429            return unnamed.map(this::trackResolved);
430         return selectPrimary(beanType).map(this::trackResolved);
431      }
432      return resolve(beanType, name).map(Supplier::get).map(this::trackResolved);
433   }
434
435   /**
436    * Returns all beans of the specified type, keyed by bean name.
437    *
438    * <p>
439    * The map keys are the bean names (empty string for unnamed beans), and the values are the bean instances.
440    * Results from the parent store are included first, then beans from this store (which override parent beans with the same name).
441    *
442    * @param <T> The bean type.
443    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
444    * @return A map of bean names to bean instances.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
445    */
446   @Override
447   @SuppressWarnings({
448      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires cast to Map<String,T>
449   })
450   public <T> Map<String,T> getBeansOfType(Class<T> beanType) {
451      checkOpen();
452      // Build the result respecting the priority order used by getBean / resolve:
453      //   defaults (lowest) < parent < entries (local) < overridingParent < overlayStack (highest)
454      // Higher-priority maps overwrite lower-priority ones with the same name.
455      Map<String,T> result = map();
456      var defaultMap = defaults.get(beanType);
457      if (nn(defaultMap))
458         defaultMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> result.put(name, (T)supplier.get()));
459      if (nn(parent))
460         parent.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
461      var typeMap = entries.get(beanType);
462      if (nn(typeMap))
463         typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> result.put(name, (T)supplier.get()));
464      if (nn(overridingParent))
465         overridingParent.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
466      var stack = overlayStack;
467      if (nn(stack) && stack.depth() > 0)
468         stack.getBeansOfType(beanType).forEach(result::put);
469      if (result.isEmpty())
470         return result;
471      return result.entrySet().stream()
472         .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(e -> beanOrder(beanType, e.getKey())))
473         .collect(LinkedHashMap::new, (m, e) -> m.put(e.getKey(), trackResolved(e.getValue())), Map::putAll);
474   }

506   /**
507    * Returns the default supplier registered locally for the specified unnamed bean type, or empty if none.
508    *
509    * <p>
510    * Parent and overriding-parent stores are <i>not</i> consulted.  This returns the supplier itself,
511    * unwrapped from any resolution chain &mdash; it lets callers promote a memoizer-backed default
512    * supplier into a higher-precedence layer (e.g. a local entry) without re-invoking the underlying
513    * factory.
514    *
515    * @param <T> The bean type.
516    * @param beanType The bean type to look up.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
517    * @return The locally-registered default supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not present.
518    */
519   public <T> Optional<Supplier<T>> getDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType) {
520      return getDefaultSupplier(beanType, null);
521   }

523   /**
524    * Returns the default supplier registered locally for the specified bean type and name, or empty if none.
525    *
526    * <p>
527    * Parent and overriding-parent stores are <i>not</i> consulted.  This returns the supplier itself,
528    * unwrapped from any resolution chain &mdash; it lets callers promote a memoizer-backed default
529    * supplier into a higher-precedence layer (e.g. a local entry) without re-invoking the underlying
530    * factory.
531    *
532    * @param <T> The bean type.
533    * @param beanType The bean type to look up.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
534    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
535    * @return The locally-registered default supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not present.
536    */
537   @SuppressWarnings({
538      "unchecked" // Cast is safe: parameterization is verified at construction.
539   })
540   public <T> Optional<Supplier<T>> getDefaultSupplier(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
541      var typeMap = defaults.get(beanType);
542      if (typeMap == null)
543         return oe();
544      var supplier = typeMap.get(emptyIfNull(name));
545      return supplier == null ? oe() : o((Supplier<T>) supplier);
546   }

612   /**
613    * Resolves a supplier for a bean of the specified type and name.
614    *
615    * <p>
616    * If no supplier with the specified name is found in this store, searches the parent store recursively.
617    *
618    * @param <T> The bean type.
619    * @param beanType The bean type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
620    * @param name The bean name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> for unnamed beans.
621    * @return The supplier, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no supplier of the specified type and name exists.
622    */
623   @SuppressWarnings({
624      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires cast for supplier resolution
625   })
626   protected <T> Optional<Supplier<T>> resolve(Class<T> beanType, String name) {
627      // (0) Push/pop overlay stack — wins over the construction-time overridingParent slot because pushed
628      // frames are "more recent".  Lazily initialized; null until the first pushOverlay() call.
629      var stack = overlayStack;
630      if (nn(stack) && stack.depth() > 0) {
631         var fromStack = stack.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
632         if (fromStack.isPresent())
633            return fromStack;
634      }
635      // (1) Overriding parent (e.g. Spring) — wins over local entries.
636      if (nn(overridingParent)) {
637         var fromOverriding = overridingParent.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
638         if (fromOverriding.isPresent())
639            return fromOverriding;
640      }
641      // (2) Local regular entries.
642      var typeMap = entries.get(beanType);
643      if (nn(typeMap)) {
644         var key = emptyIfNull(name);
645         var supplier = typeMap.get(key);
646         if (nn(supplier))
647            return o((Supplier<T>)supplier);
648      }
649      // (3) Regular parent fallback.
650      if (nn(parent)) {
651         var fromParent = parent.getBeanSupplier(beanType, name);
652         if (fromParent.isPresent())
653            return fromParent;
654      }
655      // (4) Local default suppliers (memoizer-backed framework defaults).
656      var defaultMap = defaults.get(beanType);
657      if (nn(defaultMap)) {
658         var key = emptyIfNull(name);
659         var supplier = defaultMap.get(key);
660         if (nn(supplier))
661            return o((Supplier<T>)supplier);
662      }
663      return oe();
664   }

692   /**
693    * Finds and invokes a factory method that produces a bean of type <c>beanType</c>.
694    *

697    * Otherwise, both instance and static methods on the object's class are eligible.
698    * A <jk>null</jk> <c>filter</c> accepts any qualifying method.

700    * @param <T> The bean type.

702    * @param onClassOrObject The object instance or {@link Class} whose public methods are searched.
703    *    Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
704    * @param filter Optional predicate restricting which methods are eligible.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (any method qualifies).
705    * @param extraBeans Optional bean instances visible to parameter resolution for this call only.
706    * @return The created bean wrapped in an {@link Optional}, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no matching
707    *    factory method was found.
708    * @throws BeanCreationException If a matching method was found but threw an exception during invocation.
709    */
710   @Override
711   public <T> Optional<T> createBeanFromMethod(Class<T> beanType, Object onClassOrObject, Predicate<MethodInfo> filter, Object... extraBeans) {
712      assertArgNotNull(ARG_beanType, beanType);
713      assertArgNotNull(ARG_onClassOrObject, onClassOrObject);
714      Object resource = onClassOrObject instanceof Class ? null : onClassOrObject;
715      Class<?> resourceClass = onClassOrObject instanceof Class<?> onClassOrObject2 ? onClassOrObject2 : onClassOrObject.getClass();
716      return info(resourceClass)
717         .getPublicMethod(m ->
718            m.isNotDeprecated()
719            && m.hasReturnType(beanType)
720            && (filter == null || filter.test(m))
721            && (m.isStatic() || nn(resource))
722            && m.canResolveAllParameters(this, extraBeans))
723         .map(m -> {
724            try {
725               return m.<T>inject(this, resource, extraBeans);
726            } catch (Exception e) {
727               throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to create bean of type [" + beanType.getSimpleName() + "] via method [" + m.getName() + "]", e);
728            }
729         });
730   }

740      entries.forEach((type, typeMap) -> typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> entryList.add(filteredBeanPropertyMap()

742         .a(PROP_bean, id(supplier.get()))
743         .a(PROP_name, name))));

745      defaults.forEach((type, typeMap) -> typeMap.forEach((name, supplier) -> defaultList.add(filteredBeanPropertyMap()
746         .a(PROP_type, cns(type))

750      if (nn(overridingParent)) {
751         if (overridingParent instanceof BasicBeanStore overridingParent2)
752            overridingParentValue = overridingParent2.properties();
753         else

756      var stack = overlayStack;
757      Object overlayStackValue = (nn(stack) && stack.depth() > 0) ? s(stack) : null;
758      return filteredBeanPropertyMap()
759         .a(PROP_entries, entryList)
760         .a(PROP_defaults, defaultList.isEmpty() ? null : defaultList)
761         .a(PROP_overlayStack, overlayStackValue)
762         .a(PROP_overridingParent, overridingParentValue)
763         .a(PROP_identity, id(this))

768   @Override
769   public void close() throws BeanCreationException {
770      if (closed)
771         return;
772      closed = true;
773      var errors = new BeanCreationException("Errors while invoking @PreDestroy callbacks.");
774      boolean hasErrors = false;
775      var beans = new ArrayList<>(resolvedBeans);
776      Collections.reverse(beans);
777      for (var bean : beans) {
778         for (var method : ClassInfo.of(bean).getAllMethods()) {
779            if (!method.getReturnType().is(void.class) || method.getParameterCount() != 0 || method.isAbstract() || method.isStatic())
780               continue;
781            if (method.getAnnotations().stream().noneMatch(JsrSupport::isPreDestroyAnnotation))
782               continue;
783            try {
784               method.invoke(bean);
785            } catch (Exception e) {
786               hasErrors = true;
787               errors.addSuppressed(e);
788            }
789         }
790      }
791      if (hasErrors)
792         throw errors;
793   }

795   @SuppressWarnings({
796      "unchecked" // reflective @Bean discovery — element types resolve at runtime to the value's actual class
797   })
798   private void registerConfiguration(Class<?> configType, Set<Class<?>> visited) {
799      if (!visited.add(configType))
800         return;
801      var cfg = configType.getAnnotation(Configuration.class);
802      if (cfg == null)
803         throw new BeanCreationException("Type is not @Configuration: " + configType.getName());
804      if (!matchesConditions(configType))
805         return;
806      // Annotation arrays cannot contain null elements at runtime — Java rejects null defaults at
807      // declaration time and the compiler refuses null literals in annotation values.  No defensive
808      // null check is needed here.
809      for (var imported : cfg.imports())
810         registerConfiguration(imported, visited);
811
812      // Walk the type and its superclasses; collect @Bean members on each level.  This honours
813      // the plan's "superclass inheritance of @Bean members" requirement.  Order matters here:
814      // process the highest ancestor first so subclass @Bean methods can depend on superclass
815      // beans (analogous to Spring's @Configuration inheritance).
816      Object instance = null;
817      var hierarchy = new ArrayList<Class<?>>();
818      for (var c = configType; c != null && c != Object.class; c = c.getSuperclass())
819         hierarchy.add(c);
820      Collections.reverse(hierarchy);
821      for (var c : hierarchy) {
822         for (var field : c.getDeclaredFields()) {
823            var beanAnn = field.getAnnotation(Bean.class);
824            if (beanAnn == null)
825               continue;
826            if (!matchesConditions(field))
827               continue;
828            try {
829               if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) && instance == null)
830                  instance = BeanInstantiator.of(configType, this).run();
831               field.setAccessible(true);
832               var value = field.get(java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) ? null : instance);
833               addBeanWithMeta((Class<Object>)field.getType(), value, emptyIfNull(beanName(beanAnn)), BeanSourceMeta.from(field, beanAnn));
834            } catch (Exception e) {
835               throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean field: " + field, e);
836            }
837         }
838         for (var method : c.getDeclaredMethods()) {
839            var beanAnn = method.getAnnotation(Bean.class);
840            if (beanAnn == null)
841               continue;
842            if (!matchesConditions(method))
843               continue;
844            try {
845               if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(method.getModifiers()) && instance == null)
846                  instance = BeanInstantiator.of(configType, this).run();
847               method.setAccessible(true);
848               var value = MethodInfo.of(method).inject(this, java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(method.getModifiers()) ? null : instance);
849               addBeanWithMeta((Class<Object>)method.getReturnType(), value, emptyIfNull(beanName(beanAnn)), BeanSourceMeta.from(method, beanAnn));
850            } catch (Exception e) {
851               throw new BeanCreationException("Failed to register @Bean method: " + method, e);
852            }
853         }
854      }
855   }

857   private boolean matchesConditions(java.lang.reflect.AnnotatedElement element) {
858      var classLoader = element instanceof Class<?> element2 ? element2.getClassLoader() : element.getClass().getClassLoader();
859      var ctx = new ConditionContext(this, Settings.get(), classLoader, element);
860      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(Conditional.class)) {
861         if (!BeanInstantiator.of(c.value(), this).run().matches(ctx)) {
862            LOGGER.fine(() -> "Skipping conditional element due to @Conditional: " + element);
863            return false;
864         }
865      }
866      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnClass.class)) {
867         try {
868            Class.forName(c.value(), false, classLoader);
869         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") ClassNotFoundException e) {
870            LOGGER.fine(() -> "Skipping conditional element due to missing class " + c.value() + ": " + element);
871            return false;
872         }
873      }
874      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnMissingBean.class)) {
875         var type = c.value();
876         var name = c.name().isEmpty() ? null : c.name();
877         if (type == Object.class) {
878            if (name != null && anyLocalBeanNamed(name))
879               return false;
880         } else if (hasBean(type, name)) {
881            return false;
882         }
883      }
884      for (var c : element.getAnnotationsByType(ConditionalOnProperty.class)) {
885         var value = Settings.get().get(c.name()).orElse(null);
886         if (value == null && !c.matchIfMissing())
887            return false;
888         if (value != null && !c.havingValue().isEmpty() && !c.havingValue().equals(value))
889            return false;
890      }
891      return true;
892   }

904   private <T> void addBeanWithMeta(Class<T> beanType, T bean, String name, BeanSourceMeta meta) {
905      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
906      // Duplicate-check against LOCAL entries only.  Beans present via the overridingParent or parent
907      // chain are allowed to coexist with a local registration here — the resolution order
908      // (overridingParent > local > parent > defaults) ensures the right entry wins at lookup time.
909      // This is what lets a test-time overlay installed in the overridingParent slot coexist with a
910      // local @Bean factory of the same (type, name) declared on a @Configuration class without
911      // triggering a spurious duplicate-bean error.
912      var typeMap = entries.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
913      if (typeMap.containsKey(key))
914         throw new BeanCreationException("Duplicate bean: type=" + beanType.getName() + ", name=" + key);
915      typeMap.put(key, () -> bean);
916      entryMetadata.computeIfAbsent(beanType, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).put(key, meta);
917   }

919   private <T> T trackResolved(T bean) {

922      synchronized (resolvedIdentities) {
923         if (resolvedIdentities.add(bean))
924            resolvedBeans.add(bean);
925      }
926      return bean;
927   }

929   private <T> Optional<T> selectPrimary(Class<T> beanType) {
930      // @Primary is a local-entry-only signal.  Default suppliers added via addDefaultSupplier()
931      // always carry BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT (primary = false), so iterating defaultMetadata never
932      // contributes a primary candidate — only entryMetadata is consulted here.  Parent and
933      // overridingParent stores (including Spring-backed delegates) are similarly excluded because
934      // @Primary metadata only exists on beans this store registered itself.
935      Set<String> primaryNames = st();
936      var em = entryMetadata.get(beanType);
937      if (nn(em))
938         em.forEach((name, meta) -> { if (meta.primary()) primaryNames.add(name); });
939      if (primaryNames.isEmpty())
940         return oe();
941      if (primaryNames.size() > 1)
942         throw new BeanCreationException("Multiple @Primary candidates of type " + beanType.getName());
943      var primaryName = primaryNames.iterator().next();
944      return resolve(beanType, primaryName).map(Supplier::get);
945   }

947   private int beanOrder(Class<?> type, String name) {
948      // @Order / priority is sourced from registered entries only.  Default suppliers always carry
949      // BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT (which already returns Integer.MAX_VALUE/2), so we fall through to
950      // the same constant rather than consulting defaultMetadata redundantly.
951      var key = emptyIfNull(name);
952      var m = entryMetadata.get(type);
953      if (m != null)
954         return m.getOrDefault(key, BeanSourceMeta.DEFAULT).orderValue();
955      return Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
956   }

963   private record BeanSourceMeta(boolean primary, Integer order, int priority) {
964      static final BeanSourceMeta DEFAULT = new BeanSourceMeta(false, null, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
965
966      int orderValue() {
967         return order == null ? priority : order.intValue();

970      static BeanSourceMeta from(java.lang.reflect.AnnotatedElement element, Bean bean) {
971         var order = element.getAnnotation(Order.class);
972         return new BeanSourceMeta(element.getAnnotation(Primary.class) != null, order == null ? null : order.value(), bean.priority());
973      }
